SddReviewLifecycle.keywords: review-lifecycle, master, review-state, compress, publish, MR, external-review, git, gh, sdd-review-lifecycle
SddReviewLifecycle.Mission:
Drive one review bundle from review-state to merged master through EXTERNAL review. A bundle is either a product/library scope plus all its module specs after decomposition, or one complete standalone infrastructure/interface spec. Loaded lazily AFTER every member is written in review-state. I do NOT author spec content — the authoring flow did; I finalize the bounded semantic bytes, obtain one delta-only operator approval, then run one integrated spec-only critic target/write-set and derive the separate role-validated publication-set of durable authoring outputs. I publish exactly that publication-set for review, wait for the operator's verdict, and merge the reviewed commit unchanged on approval.
Git is native `git` + `gh` via bash — no separate VCS client. Per `AX_SPEC_LIFECYCLE`, external review sees final master-form bytes: no semantic compression, merge/delete, collision repair, or other rewrite is allowed after approval.
SddReviewLifecycle.BeliefState:
Inherited from the loading directive (already in context): SESSION_FILE_FORMAT
A spec lives in two states. **master** — clean file (no Change Manifest, no marks), the target on the main branch. **review-state** — the same file on a working branch during a change: the target text is written IN PLACE (everything else byte-for-byte, so the branch diff reads like a normal PR), with the temporary change manifest loaded by the owning authoring flow at the top and affected lines marked `✚` (new) / `~` (changed). New IDs are appended to the end of their section; existing IDs are never renumbered.
`greenfield` (∅ → review-state): the first version is written directly as review-state with `ТИП: greenfield` and NO per-line marks (everything is new — the diff against an empty file already shows it). `refine` / `pivot` edit an existing master in place WITH marks.
The spec change is a reviewable PR (design-PR). Before the internal critic, finalize semantic bytes (Decision Log compression including merge/delete, ID collision repair, pivot supersession), then obtain the operator's delta-only final hierarchy Approval. The critic loop is necessary but NOT sufficient and owns one global five-result cap across any correction/finalization return; such a return preserves its scratch and next round number. Critic target/write ownership stays specs-only; the separate VCS publication-set may add only mechanically attributed durable authoring outputs (registered research, canonical portal/index files, and the exact session-ignore addition), and any other dirty path halts. After the critic, approve only its actual delta, remove review scaffolding with Critic Rounds last, and pass the final-byte integrity check. Publish exactly the role-validated clean publication-set bytes. External approval names one reviewed commit; merge that same commit with no semantic rewrite afterward. Implementation (scaffold → execute) follows the merged master.
Reconcile has one narrow non-semantic exception: an explicitly classified editorial correction (spelling, formatting, or a mechanical link correction to an already-defined target) may use its frozen task-free target-set plus exact `sdd-check --all` direct receipt. It must change no GOAL, requirement, behaviour, contract, inventory, architecture, dependency, BDD acceptance, risk, or Decision Log meaning. Any such delta is semantic and returns to the authoring + integrated review lifecycle above before scaffold/reopen/execute.
A spec MUST NOT be left in review-state once its change is closed — that is drift the tools track (`sdd-check`): a malformed review-state or a manifest lingering past its lifetime is surfaced with the reason, so the agent fixes it or escalates.
Review lifecycle owns this exact VCS surface. Resolve every placeholder to a literal argument before one command call; never use shell substitution, variables, pipes, loops, `echo`, redirection, or `--help`. A ref literal is valid only when it uses ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore, slash, or hyphen; starts with a letter or digit; is at most 128 characters; and has no empty, dot, dot-dot, terminal-dot, terminal-slash, `.lock`, or `@{` component/form. A review slug is derived from the primary spec's canonical scope segment and must match `[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*`. A PR number is a non-zero decimal integer. Read/freeze: `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all`, `git hash-object -- `, `git diff --cached --name-only`, `git diff --exit-code -- `, `git ls-files --stage -- `, `git rev-parse HEAD`, `git branch --show-current`, `gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef --jq .defaultBranchRef.name`. Derive, validate, and freeze literal ``, ``, and `` before mutation. Immediately before both staging and commit, rerun `git branch --show-current` and require exact equality with frozen ``. Write the complete PR body only through a file-write tool to `.claude/tmp/sdd-review-.md`, freeze that literal as ``, and pass its opaque bytes only by `--body-file `. Never place any PR-body text in a shell command. Publish: `git add -- `, `git commit -m "sdd(): publish specification"`, `git push --set-upstream origin `, `gh pr list --head --base --state open --json number,url --limit 2`, `gh pr create --base --head --title "SDD : publish specification" --body-file `, or `gh pr edit --base --title "SDD : publish specification" --body-file `. After create, rerun the same head-plus-base list command; after create or reuse require exactly one row, validate and freeze its literal `` and ``, and use that number for every later PR operation. Prove publication with `gh pr view --json number,url,headRefOid,baseRefName,state --jq '{number:.number,url:.url,headRefOid:.headRefOid,baseRefName:.baseRefName,state:.state}'`. Merge/prove: `gh pr merge --merge --match-head-commit `, `gh pr view --json state,mergedAt,mergeCommit,baseRefName --jq '{state:.state,mergedAt:.mergedAt,mergeCommitOid:.mergeCommit.oid,baseRefName:.baseRefName}'`, `git fetch origin `, and `git merge-base --is-ancestor FETCH_HEAD`. Copy each command's literal output (or exact exit code for the ancestry check) into orchestration state/report; never reconstruct or capture it through shell syntax. No other mutating VCS command, squash, rebase, force-push, or implicit interactive prompt is allowed.
SddReviewLifecycle.HaltConditions: | 🛑 ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW` | Change published — session waits for the operator's verdict (feedback or «no comments»). A PAUSE, not a failure. | | `H_DIRTY_TREE_NOT_THIS_CHANGE` | The git working tree carries changes unrelated to this spec change — operator resolves before publish | | `H_PR_PUBLICATION_INPUT_MISSING` | A derived head branch, base branch, review slug, or file-written PR body is missing or fails the VCS contract's restricted grammar before publication | | `H_CURRENT_BRANCH_MISMATCH` | Exact `git branch --show-current` output differs from the frozen validated head branch before staging or commit | | `H_REVIEWED_HEAD_MISMATCH` | Local HEAD, PR head, or PR base differs from the frozen reviewed publication state | | `H_MERGE_POSTCONDITION_FAILED` | PR is not MERGED, merge metadata is incomplete, or the exact reviewed commit is not an ancestor of the fetched merged base |

Step.Goal: Make the authoring bundle semantically final before its critic cycle starts.
Step.Action:
Per `AX_SPEC_LIFECYCLE`, before any sensor dispatch, finalize every spec's semantics: resolve ID collisions; for `pivot`, mark superseded decisions; and compress the ENTIRE Decision Log against `AX_DECISION_LOG_NON_OBVIOUS`. Dissolve derivable entries into their owning sections, retain genuine compromises/risks/exceptions, and merge duplicate conclusions into one surviving id. Repeat this step locally until a pass makes no semantic edit. Report `Decision Log: растворено, оставлено, слито` once for the stable result.
If `## Critic Rounds` already exists because the operator corrected a post-critic delta, it is immutable scratch: semantic finalization MUST preserve the section and its round numbering exactly. Returning to the critic continues the same cycle and same global result count; compression is never a reason to restart at Round 1. A changed target-set/write-set still follows the critic's explicit RESTART rule.

Step.Goal: Approve the finalized authoring bytes before integrated review.
Step.Action: Show the exact finalized hierarchy and only the delta from the last operator-approved authoring packet; do not re-ask settled choices. Approval Check. STOP. While unanswered, return `TerminalDecision: pause`. A correction returns to STEP_1; acceptance freezes `` and continues to STEP_2. This is the final hierarchy approval: it is always before the integrated critic, publication, merge, and downstream handoff.

Step.Goal: Internal review until mechanically ready — necessary, not sufficient.
Step.Action:
Dispatch the critic (isolated), on a worker-tier model (`AX_CRITIC_MODEL_TIER`), on the complete review bundle as one stable target-set — `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/critic.directive.xml")` (product / design lenses: completeness · implementation-autonomy · understanding · product-value). The critic directive alone owns findings, same-worker continuation/fallback, the five-result global automatic cap, spec-only target/write state, and readiness. It returns exact npx gennady sdd-check --review-ready and npx gennady sdd-check --review-publication [secondary...] outputs with `## Critic Rounds` still present. Auxiliary publication paths never enter critic target/write ownership. This lifecycle neither reconstructs that loop nor runs one critic per file.
If the critic's stable bytes differ from ``, show one delta-only Approval Check containing only critic-caused changes. Acceptance is a non-mutating terminal disposition for these final bytes. A correction preserves `## Critic Rounds`, returns to STEP_1, and then continues the SAME critic worker/cycle with the next round number. It never resets the global count; if five results already exist, a sixth dispatch still requires the critic's exact operator cap disposition. While either Approval Check waits, return `TerminalDecision: pause`.

Step.Goal: Remove review scaffolding last and freeze the exact bytes external review will approve.
Step.Action:
Preserve the critic's literal ordered JSON `publication-set`, roles, and `publication-state`; it is not the critic target/write-set. With `## Critic Rounds` still present, rerun exact reviewReadiness and reviewPublication ToolCalls below and require the same target-set, write-set, publication-set, and publication-state. Any mismatch or dirty path halts. Then mechanically remove every `CHANGE_MANIFEST` and strip `✚`/`~` prefixes without changing the owned line content. Remove `## Critic Rounds` LAST, only after the finalized bytes have an accepted terminal Approval and no semantic work remains. No artifact edit is permitted afterward.
Run exact integrityCheck; it MUST be clean of `SDD_REVIEW_STATE_STUCK` / `SDD_REVIEW_INCONSISTENT`. For every exact ``, run exact `git hash-object -- ` and record the literal ` → ` map. These are the only bytes eligible for staging/review. npx gennady sdd-check --review-ready Inputs : =primary artifact path whose Critic Rounds embeds the frozen bundle. Use reviewReadiness. npx gennady sdd-check --review-publication [secondary...] Inputs , [secondary...]: same ordered spec arguments returned by STEP_2. Use reviewPublication. npx gennady sdd-check --all Inputs : current project root containing every finalized publication member. Use integrityCheck.

Step.Goal: Stage, commit, and push exactly the allowed final-byte bundle.
Step.Action:
Under `AX_REVIEW_VCS_COMMANDS`, run exact `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all` and require its path set to equal the preserved `publication-set` paths exactly; otherwise `H_DIRTY_TREE_NOT_THIS_CHANGE`. Before mutation, derive `` from exact `git branch --show-current`, `` from exact `gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef --jq .defaultBranchRef.name`, and `` from the primary spec's canonical scope segment. Copy the outputs literally, validate them against the contract's restricted grammars, require different head and base refs, and freeze all three; missing or invalid input is `H_PR_PUBLICATION_INPUT_MISSING`. Use a file-write tool, not bash, to write the complete operator-facing Markdown body to exact `.claude/tmp/sdd-review-.md`; freeze that literal ``. Body content is opaque and may contain Markdown code spans, dollar-parenthesis text, and single or double quotes: never interpolate any of it into a command, and never use `echo`, redirection, or a shell variable to create or pass it.
Immediately before staging, rerun exact `git branch --show-current`, copy its literal output, and require equality with frozen ``; otherwise `H_CURRENT_BRANCH_MISMATCH` before any VCS mutation. Then, in this exact order: `git add -- `; verify `git diff --cached --name-only` equals the publication path set exactly; verify `git diff --exit-code -- ` is empty; run exact `git ls-files --stage -- ` and require one stage-0 row per publication path whose staged blob id equals that path's recorded ``. Immediately before commit, rerun exact `git branch --show-current` and again require literal equality with frozen ``; otherwise `H_CURRENT_BRANCH_MISMATCH` and do not commit. Then run exact `git commit -m "sdd(): publish specification"`; run exact `git rev-parse HEAD` and copy its literal output into orchestration state/report as `` (no shell assignment); run exact `git push --set-upstream origin `. Run exact `gh pr list --head --base --state open --json number,url --limit 2` and copy its literal output. Empty → run exact `gh pr create --base --head --title "SDD : publish specification" --body-file `, then rerun the same head-plus-base list query. One existing row → validate/freeze its non-zero decimal `` and literal ``, then run exact `gh pr edit --base --title "SDD : publish specification" --body-file `. More than one row, or anything other than exactly one row after creation, halts instead of guessing. After either branch, store the one literal `` and `` in orchestration state/report. Run exact `gh pr view --json number,url,headRefOid,baseRefName,state --jq '{number:.number,url:.url,headRefOid:.headRefOid,baseRefName:.baseRefName,state:.state}'`, copy its literal JSON output, and require the same number and URL, `state=OPEN`, `headRefOid=`, and `baseRefName=`; otherwise `H_REVIEWED_HEAD_MISMATCH`. Present the stored literal URL and commit hash. Every PR operation after identity resolution carries `` explicitly; never select by current branch and never call `--help`.

`H_AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW` — return `TerminalDecision: pause`; preserve the SDD session. The operator reviews the MR and returns with feedback or «no comments». Publication is not terminal completion and never closes the session.

Feedback → return `TerminalDecision: continue`, restore review-state evidence for the exact critic spec target/write-set, apply edits in place, and return to STEP_1. This is a new external review revision and therefore a new critic cycle; the whole finalize/recheck/stage/commit/push/remote-head verification sequence runs again and produces a new reviewed commit. «no comments» (approved) → `continue`, STEP_6.

Step.Goal: Merge exactly the externally reviewed commit, without rewriting it.
Step.Action:
Under `AX_REVIEW_VCS_COMMANDS`, run exact `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all` and require no local staged/unstaged change in the frozen publication-set. Run exact `git rev-parse HEAD` and exact `gh pr view --json number,url,headRefOid,baseRefName,state --jq '{number:.number,url:.url,headRefOid:.headRefOid,baseRefName:.baseRefName,state:.state}'`; copy both literal outputs and require the returned number and URL to equal the stored PR identity, local HEAD and `headRefOid` to equal stored ``, `baseRefName` to equal stored ``, and `state=OPEN`, else `H_REVIEWED_HEAD_MISMATCH`. Do not edit, stage, commit, or push between approval and merge. Run exact `gh pr merge --merge --match-head-commit ` — never squash or rebase.
Then run exact `gh pr view --json state,mergedAt,mergeCommit,baseRefName --jq '{state:.state,mergedAt:.mergedAt,mergeCommitOid:.mergeCommit.oid,baseRefName:.baseRefName}'` and copy its literal JSON output; require `state=MERGED`, non-null `mergedAt`, non-empty `mergeCommitOid`, and the stored `baseRefName`. Run exact `git fetch origin `, then exact `git merge-base --is-ancestor FETCH_HEAD` and record exit code 0. Any mismatch/nonzero result is `H_MERGE_POSTCONDITION_FAILED` and returns `TerminalDecision: pause`. Only this proof permits `TerminalDecision: continue` back to the authoring flow's downstream handoff. This lifecycle is never a terminal owner and never runs `sdd-session close`.

SddReviewLifecycle.HardForbidden: - Publishing review-state bytes, or performing semantic compression / merge / delete / ID-collision repair after external review starts. - Starting the integrated critic before semantic finalization and the final hierarchy Approval, resetting its round count after compression/correction, or removing scratch before the accepted final bytes are stable. - Publishing a change whose critic did not pass exact `npx gennady sdd-check --review-ready `, derive exact `npx gennady sdd-check --review-publication [secondary...]`, and then remove its scratch as the last review-scaffolding mutation. - Conflating the spec-only critic target/write-set with the role-bearing publication-set. - Staging anything except the exact frozen publication-set, or committing before staged paths and blob ids match its frozen final bytes. - Merging when local HEAD or remote PR head differs from the stored literal ``. - Selecting a PR implicitly from the current branch, or using an unstored PR number/URL after head-plus-base identity resolution. - Passing commit/PR free text through shell interpolation, or passing a PR body by any mechanism except the frozen `.claude/tmp/` body file. - Squash/rebase merge, merge without `--match-head-commit`, or handoff without merged-status plus ancestry proof. - Authoring unrelated spec content — the loading flow owns that; I only review, finalize, publish, and merge the bounded change.
